guests.name: Tuntun Yadav
guests.summary: Tuntun Yadav is a Bhojpuri singer, music director and folk artist from Ara, Bihar. He is one of the contemporary names in the Bhojpuri music industry.

guests.name: Dev Singh
guests.summary: Dev Singh, also known as Dev Singh Rajput, is a Bhojpuri film actor known for antagonist roles. He has worked in more than 50 films.

guests.name: Vijay Chauhan
guests.summary: Vijay Chauhan is a Bhojpuri singer, music composer, lyricist and actor. His work includes both energetic festive tracks and devotional or socially conscious music.

guests.name: Kalyani Singh
guests.summary: Kalyani Singh is an Indian actress, model and digital content creator from Bihar. She has taken part in pageants and in MTV Model 2020.

guests.name: Vinod Mishra
guests.summary: Vinod Mishra is an Indian actor, screenwriter and dialogue writer. He has worked in Bhojpuri films and Hindi television, often playing stern father and antagonist roles.
